excerpts:
Skip to main content
Haaland wins 2025/26 Premier League Golden Boot award
24 May 2026 Man City striker earns the prize for the third time, after scoring 27 goals The 2025/26 Coca-Cola Premier League Golden Boot has been awarded to Erling Haaland , after he scored 27 goals for Manchester City to be the leading goalscorer. It is the third time Haaland has won the prestigious award for a third time, following on from 2022/23 and 2023/24. Haaland is now one off equalling the record for most Golden Boots, currently shared by Arsenal legend Thierry Henry and Liverpool icon Mohamed Salah - who each won four apiece.
